the land value is a location characteristic that can be determined by the use of a consistent method of calculation.
land values represent the location of a property.
the public valuation expert committees in Germany are not able to determine the location of a territory by means of a land value, as the location of a property is a complex issue.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question, which criteria are used by the public valuation experts in order to calculate and weight land values.
the development of an approach to determining land values in Germany, which is based on a consistent and transparent method of calculation and weighting of location characteristics.
the development and application of a method to determine land values by location in a transparent and comparable way.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the land value is a very important indicator of location.
a consistent method of calculating land value is needed for all locations in Germany.
land values are not the sole indicator of location, but that land values are only one of the many factors of location.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the land value represents a location indicator and is dependent on the location.
a consistent and nationwide applicable method for the determination of land values by location is necessary to provide market transparency.
a consistent and transparent determination of land values in a territory is possible.

the provision of market transparency for land value is a key issue to support the decision making process in the public sector.
